metadata.title: Density Pass 36 -- The Angle: Cushing's Last Stand and Armistead's Breakthrough (Ticks 546-558)
metadata.description: The climax of Pickett's Charge at The Angle in the stone wall. Cushing firing his last two guns at point-blank range. Armistead leading his men over the wall with his hat on his sword. The high-water mark of the Confederacy. Webb's brigade breaking then holding. Armistead mortally wounded at the guns. The charge collapses.

placements.notes: Cushing's Battery A -- 2 guns left of 6. Cushing wounded twice, holding his intestines with one hand, commanding with the other.
Armistead's brigade 50 yards from the wall -- his hat on his sword, raised high so men can see him through the smoke
Garnett's brigade closing on The Angle -- Garnett has ridden his horse into the charge, knowing he will die
Webb's Philadelphia Brigade at The Angle -- waiting behind the stone wall
Cushing pulls his last 2 guns to the wall -- he will fire them from within 10 yards of Armistead. Canister at point-blank range.
Armistead at the wall -- Follow me!
Garnett at The Angle -- Garnett killed here, his body never identified
Webb's front line breaking -- some of the 71st PA running. Webb furious, trying to hold them.
Armistead OVER THE WALL -- the high-water mark of the Confederacy. 150 men with him at Cushing's guns.
CUSHING KILLED -- shot through the head as he fires his last round. Battery A is silent.
Harrow's brigade charging TO The Angle from the left -- Hancock has sent everyone
Hall's brigade hitting Armistead from the right -- the counterattack from both sides
Armistead FALLS -- shot at the guns. He is captured by Union soldiers, asks them to give his watch to Hancock. Dies 2 days later.
Webb's brigade back on the wall -- The Angle is held. The charge has broken.
Garnett's brigade survivors retreating -- Garnett dead, never found. 750 of 1459 casualties.
Kemper's brigade retreating -- Kemper wounded, near death. Will survive. Will live until 1895.
